# Native capture: Flow refire rejection in a start-filter subset

A fresh 30-day scratch org was created from a campaign Dev Hub and the synthetic project deployed. Project Flow, action, trigger and guard sources are API 62; ceiling files are their API 67 variants. API 67 Flow/action/trigger/guard was deployed first and tests at 62 and 67 run, then all four were redeployed at API 62 and the 62 class rerun. A three-record statement contains two matching records separated by one nonmatching control. A before-update trigger rejects either matching record. Capture records the original statement index, null ID/fields, status and full message with the synthetic record ID replaced by [record]. Successful 2/3/199 matching-input and overlength controls are included. The public Salesforce developer-guide link is retained; other URLs and sensitive identifiers are scrubbed. The scratch org was deleted and ScratchOrgInfo status verified as Deleted.
